title: Local Turnpike Stability for Two-Population Second-Order Mean-Field Game Systems
summary: This paper establishes a local turnpike property for a two-population, second-order mean-field game system with a quadratic Hamiltonian, in which the running cost for each population may depend on both population densities. In the case of two populations, imposing a scalar stability condition separately on each species is not sufficient because it neglects cross-interaction effects.
